name: ^context\.(agentLoader|deploymentLoader)$
reason: routing context loaders injected by the server; storage reads taken as inputs

name: ^new Direct(NotFound|Forbidden)Error$
reason: constructs the error the twin rethrows; only its name, message and init are read

name: ^conversationFilesSchema\.safeParse$
reason: zod validation of the body; success and data are its documented result

name: ^adapter\.actions$
reason: channel adapter's reply surface; returned unchanged or its throw propagated

name: ^new ConvexClient$
reason: Convex SDK constructor; the client is returned unread

name: ^\(client as unknown as \{ setAdminAuth\(key: string\): void \}\)\.setAdminAuth$
reason: Convex SDK auth setter; no answer is read

name: ^client\.onUpdate$
reason: Convex SDK subscription; its return value is unused and its callbacks are entered as inputs

name: ^\$enter:arg[23]$
reason: watchChannelConnections' own rows and error callbacks; entering one carries the SDK's answer

name: ^(resolve|onChange)$
reason: caller callbacks; resolve's answer is an input, onChange's is ignored

name: ^send$
reason: ackInbound's caller-supplied callback, started without waiting; nothing is read from it

name: FakeConvexClient
reason: test stand-in for the Convex SDK client; the twin passes it along and never reads it
